text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a small refresh of the hello-mini quickstart to add a PKCE OAuth example and a tiny local token helper for devs. I opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Looking for: snippet review (JS + Py), a note about redirect URIs, and someone to run a quick deploy smoke test on mac/linux. cc @ben @carol :wave:

ben: Nice! Can you include the env var examples (CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN, REDWOOD_TOKEN_HELPER) and a short curl token exchange sample? I can sketch the JS snippet if you want. :+1:

carol: Aisha — please avoid calling out the old cookie helper in examples. Use the new local helper binary (decklink) we added to dev tools. If the docs mention installing it, add the checksum or link to the releases page.

Aisha: Good call. I'll swap the cookie example for decklink and add the install + checksum line. Will also add the env vars and curl example. Pushed a commit to the PR with the outline.

docs-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #4321 — 1 change file (hello-mini.md) — build #7842 ✅

mike: I can run the smoke on mac tomorrow morning. Which commands should I run exactly?

Aisha: Thanks! Run the quickstart steps in the README: 
```
# install deps
npm install 
# start dev server
npm run dev 
# request a token via decklink
./decklink auth --client-id $CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback 
# exchange token
curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback'
```
Also try opening http://localhost:3000 and minting a test completion (no real model call required).

sam: left a couple inline comments on the PR about wording (shorten the intro paragraph and clarify the security note around localhost redirect URIs). PR number is referenced in comments.

luis: small note — add explicit redirect URI example `http://localhost:3000/callback` and mention that some browsers block 3rd-party cookies on 3rd-party auth flows. Might help reduce confusion.

ben: I pushed a suggested JS snippet to the PR: uses fetch + async/await and shows storing token in decklink rather than localStorage. Quick snippet: 
```js
async function exchangeCode(code) {
  const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/exchange', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ code })
  });
  return res.json();
}
```
Tweaked wording for privacy note.

Aisha: I applied most of the comments and updated the intro and security note. Thanks for the snippets, ben. I also added a tiny section on migrating from the old cookie helper to decklink (one-liner + command).

carol: Can you add a note about the supported versions of the SDK (>= 0.9.0) and link to the migration guide? Also add a single line about Dedicated/private deployments — e.g., when using a private auth endpoint, set AUTH_DOMAIN accordingly.

Aisha: Will do — adding SDK compatibility and a short callout for Dedicated. Pushing last edits now.

docs-bot: CI: spellcheck passed. Build preview: https://deploy-preview-4321--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-mini.html

mike: Smoke test done (macOS 12.6). Decklink binary installed, token flow works, dev server loads, sample UI shows "Hello, tester". No model calls attempted. All green from my side. ✅

Aisha: Amazing—thank you! I'll merge after one more Windows/Linux confirmation. Leaving a note in the PR for QA to run a quick smoke on linux (Ubuntu 22.04).

sam: QA scheduled a run later today. If no issues, we can ship the updated quickstart by EOD.

Aisha: Thanks everyone — merging once the linux run is green. I'll post an announcement in #all-hands and update the quickstart checklist. :rocket:
